tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) E-Commerce Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, production support and techno-functional analysis of business requirements.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Java Softwareentwickler / Developer (m/w/d) für SAP E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Maify GmbH’s focus on cutting-edge SAP-based e-commerce solutions. With more than five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that matches the senior developer role you seek.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features, covering product, catalog and pricing, for a global enterprise.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs, enabling seamless storefront and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and guide junior developers.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Java Softwareentwickler / Developer (m/w/d) für SAP E-Commerce
cover_de.hook: Die Ausrichtung von Maify GmbH auf innovative SAP-Commerce-Lösungen begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Fachwissen für die Senior-Position mit.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Funktionen für Produkt-, Katalog- und Preisverwaltung in einem globalen Unternehmen.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Erstellte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Web-Services sowie Headless-APIs für nahtlose Storefront- und Drittanbieter-Integrationen.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Konzipierte PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub und löste Integrationsengpässe zwischen ERP und MDM.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Leitung
bullets.text: Analysierte gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen Anforderungen, schrieb User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und leitete Junior-Entwickler.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, freue mich auf ein Gespräch

tailoring.why_company: Maify GmbH is a recognized leader in delivering SAP-Commerce solutions for German mid-market firms. Its commitment to innovative, headless e-commerce platforms aligns perfectly with my experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, API-first development and large-scale integrations, allowing me to contribute immediately to client success and platform evolution.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Maify scale its SAP-Commerce projects with my proven Java and Hybris expertise, delivering robust, headless solutions for demanding e-commerce clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to bring my Java, API and integration experience to Maify GmbH’s e-commerce team. Could we discuss potential opportunities?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your CCv2 deployment pipeline, extend OCC/Spartacus integrations and streamline PIM-ERP data flows, leveraging my proven SAP Commerce Cloud track record. My hands-on experience with production support ensures rapid issue resolution and stable releases.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Java Softwareentwickler / Developer (m/w/d) für SAP E-Commerce
tailoring.email_body: Ich bin Kranti Chavan, Senior Java-Entwickler mit über fünf Jahren SAP Commerce Cloud-Erfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell. Maifys Fokus auf innovative SAP-E-Commerce-Lösungen begeistert mich. Ich bringe tiefes Know-how in Java, Hybris, OCC-APIs und PIM-Integration mit und kann sofort Mehrwert schaffen. Gerne bespreche ich, wie ich Ihre Projekte voranbringen kann. Lebenslauf und Anschreiben liegen bei.
